verified.catalyst: Medtronic's remaining ~90% stake in MiniMed (MMED) is slated to be separated via a split-off exchange offer targeted for completion by end of calendar 2026, retiring MDT shares at the customary discount.
verified.dated_milestone: Split-off exchange offer launch/completion targeted by end of CY2026; next hard checkpoint is MDT's FQ1 FY27 earnings (~late Aug 2026), where management updates separation timing; IPO 180-day lockup/underwriter-research window expired ~Sep 2026 is the practical earliest launch.
verified.instrument: MDT common equity (optional participation in the exchange offer itself when launched); MMED common is the paired leg
verified.bloom_gates: G2 only - a concrete, board-committed corporate action with a completed first step (IPO closed 2026-03-09, MDT retains 90.03%) and a stated end-CY2026 completion target. G1 fails (no external counterparty; this is an internal separation). G3 fails - the value of the retained stake is fully observable via MMED's public quote ($16.93, below the $20 IPO price), so there is no unpriced figure.
verified.edge: L - the separation has been public since 2025, the IPO already priced and re-rated the diabetes asset, MMED trades openly so the stub math is transparent, and at ~$106B market cap the diabetes unit is too small a fraction of MDT for even a fully accretive split-off to move the equity materially. The only real alpha is the mechanical 7-8% exchange-offer discount, which is a short-duration trade for holders, not a re-rating thesis.
verified.primary_source: Medtronic plc FY2026 Form 10-K (filed ~June 2026, sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001613103/000162828026044354/mdt-20260424.htm) confirming 90.03% retained ownership post-IPO and split-off as preferred path; MiniMed Group 8-K IPO closing 2026-03-09; MedTech Dive, "Medtronic lowers earnings forecast after MiniMed IPO" (2026) on end-CY2026 completion target. Prices as of 2026-07-20.
verified.analysis: The catalyst is genuinely real, dated, and forward: MiniMed's IPO closed 2026-03-09 at $20/share leaving Medtronic with 90.03%, and management has stated the preferred path to finish the separation is a split-off exchange offer targeted for completion by end of CY2026 (reaffirmed alongside the FY27 high-single-digit non-GAAP EPS growth outlook). But the structural step-out fails the asymmetry test: MMED is already publicly quoted at $16.93 (15% below its IPO price), so the retained stake is marked to market daily and nothing about the stub is hidden - and MDT's FY26 EPS cut for MiniMed dilution has already been absorbed. Gap noted: the exchange offer's terms, ratio, and formal launch date have not been filed, so the discount capture is a possibility rather than a datable trade; without that S-4/Schedule TO this stays a monitor, not a position.

verified.analysis: Verified: on 2026-06-30 Mesoblast said it received a BLA filing number and REQUESTED a modular (rolling) review for rexlemestrocel-L in prevention of life-threatening GI bleeding from RV dysfunction in end-stage HF/LVAD patients — not a completed, accepted BLA, and the triage note's "ischemic HF" framing conflates this with the earlier June 2025 FDA-alignment release. Real event and genuinely forward, but it fails the DATED gate outright and clears no Bloom gate, so it belongs on passive watch rather than as a tradeable dated binary; re-triage if and when FDA accepts the completed BLA and assigns a PDUFA date. Gap: I could not source any post-July-1 company or FDA statement setting a submission-completion target.

verified.catalyst: FDA priority-review PDUFA decision on zilurgisertib (ALK2 inhibitor, licensed from Incyte) for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva in patients 12+, with a hard action date of September 26, 2026.
verified.dated_milestone: PDUFA action date 2026-09-26 (next hard date); launch targeted year-end 2026 if approved
verified.instrument: Common equity; the clean expression would be Oct-2026 calls straddling the PDUFA, but sizing should be minimal given the payoff is immaterial to a $6.0B cap
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: FDA, with Incyte as licensor) + G2 (concrete commitment: accepted NDA under Priority Review with a statutory action date). G3 FAILS — the only specific figure management has given is ">$200M global peak sales," which is ~3% of market cap and already in sell-side models, so it is not an unpriced number.
verified.edge: L — dated and forward, but the informational asymmetry is gone and the economic asymmetry never existed
verified.primary_source: Mirum/Incyte press release + Q1 2026 business update, ir.mirumpharma.com and businesswire 2026-05-06 (PDUFA 2026-09-26, guidance raise); ENDO 2026 late-breaker announcement, businesswire 2026-06-04; price/market cap via FMP profile 2026-07-20
verified.analysis: The catalyst is genuinely real, dated, forward and unfired: FDA accepted the zilurgisertib NDA in FOP under Priority Review with a September 26, 2026 PDUFA, and it is not a macro bet. But it fails on asymmetry twice over. First, the de-risking event already fired — positive pivotal Phase 2 PROGRESS data (Cohort 1 primary endpoint, new HO lesions at Week 24 by whole-body CT) read out positive and were presented at ENDO 2026 in June; MIRM jumped ~15% on the data and now trades at $118.86 against a 52-week range of $50.25-$130, i.e. near the high after a ~135% re-rate, so approval is broadly consensus and the PDUFA is a low-payoff confirmation rather than a coin-flip. Second, the triage note's own objection is decisive: management guides zilurgisertib to only >$200M global peak sales against a $6.0B market cap and $660-680M of 2026 product-sales guidance (Q1 2026 net product sales $159.9M, LIVMARLI $113.8M, +55% y/y), so even a clean approval moves NAV a few percent while a CRL is the larger tail — negative skew. The bigger value driver by management's and sell-side framing is volixibat in PSC/PBC (~$1.7B unadjusted peak), which is a different, undated lane. Gap: I did not verify the exact NDA-acceptance date or the undisclosed Incyte royalty/milestone economics, which would only further dilute Mirum's share of the FOP payoff, not improve it.

CORRECTIONS: (1) the headline binary has NO pinned date — "mid-2026" is already effectively lapsed as of 20-Jul with no readout, so slippage into H2 is the base case, which directly undermines the proposed Aug/Sep-expiry long-call expression (theta burn on an undated event); use longer-dated or wait for a date announcement. (3) The 23-Jun $200M raise removes financing risk but was equity issued into a stock ~69% below its $62.75 52-wk high, i.e. dilution already taken; single-asset concentration means an IZAR-1 miss is a step-function down, not a drawdown.
verified.analysis: Verified via company IR/StockTitan: MoonLake is a single-asset sonelokimab story with three genuinely forward, unfired dated events — IZAR-1 PsA Week-16 topline (mid-2026), the HS BLA submission (late-Sept 2026) and PDUFA-date allocation (late-Nov 2026), with IZAR-2 in H2 2026. The triage note is right that HS is largely de-risked and re-rated (Week-52 data and FDA pre-BLA alignment already public), but the PsA readouts are hard efficacy binaries — IZAR-2 uniquely carries a risankizumab active reference arm — and at a ~$1.6B market cap post-de-rating the PsA optionality does not look fully paid for, while the June $200M raise removes near-term financing risk into the events. Gap: I could not pin an exact IZAR-1 date (company says only "mid 2026") and found a conflicting third-party source implying Q1-2027, so timing precision is the weakest link; not a macro bet.

verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: FDA, NDA accepted for filing) + G2 (concrete commitment: hard PDUFA action date 2026-12-22, standard review) + G3 (specific unpriced figure: EV ~$1.15B = $1.80B mcap less $646.1M cash at 3/31/26, for an approvable first-in-class aldosterone synthase inhibitor in a multi-million-patient US resistant-HTN market)
verified.edge: H - fixed forward date, de-rated tape, EV ~$1.15B net of cash
verified.primary_source: Mineralys Therapeutics IR press release, "FDA Acceptance of NDA for Lorundrostat... and Topline Explore-OSA Trial Results," 2026-03-09 (ir.mineralystx.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/93); corroborated by Q1 2026 results release 2026-05-06 ($646.1M cash, runway into 2028) and FMP quote 2026-07-20 ($27.09, mcap $1.796B)
verified.kill_fact: Catalyst survives: FDA accepted the lorundrostat NDA on 2026-03-09 with PDUFA target action date 2026-12-22 (Mineralys IR release detail/93, reconfirmed in the 2026-05-06 Q1 release and 8-K), and Q1 cash/investments of $646.1M funds operations into 2028 - forward, unfired, not financing-contingent. Two load-bearing errors: (1) "first-in-class aldosterone synthase inhibitor" is FALSE - AstraZeneca's baxdrostat is 6-7 months ahead and sets ASI class pricing/access; lorundrostat is second-in-class, which is precisely the drawdown driver the line cites yet then contradicts. (2) The valuation math is understated by ~50%: market cap is $2.39B at $27.09 (2026-07-17), so EV = ~$1.75B, NOT the claimed ~$1.15B; and with ~88M shares outstanding, net cash is ~$7.32/share, NOT ~$9.75. The CRL floor is therefore materially lower and the "cheap optionality" framing weaker than stated. Also unresolved: no primary confirmation of adcomm status or review designation (priority vs standard) - the acceptance release is silent on both.
verified.analysis: Verified real, dated and forward: FDA accepted the lorundrostat NDA on 2026-03-09 with a PDUFA target action date of 2026-12-22 (company IR release; reconfirmed in the 2026-05-06 Q1 release), and Q1 cash/investments of $646.1M funds operations into 2028, so this is not a financing-contingent story. The event has not fired and has not been re-rated - shares sit at $27.09, 43% below the 52-week high and below the 200dma, with the drawdown attributable to AstraZeneca baxdrostat competition and the missed Explore-OSA AHI primary endpoint rather than to the regulatory path itself, leaving ~$1.15B EV against an approvable first-in-class aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Gap in verification: I did not independently confirm the absence of an advisory committee meeting or any post-Q1 (May-July 2026) FDA correspondence, mid-cycle communication or competitor label news, and the reference price is a single quote snapshot rather than a full ownership/short-interest workup; downside on a CRL is real but floored well above the ~$9.75/share net cash.
